Live v10: Weekly progress chart, start-of-week dotted needles, one-line headers, quieter top

Dom (Nov 5): the mountain becomes Weekly progress - triangle peaks per kickoff window from actual
points (still-to-play as faint outlines), a gold NOW bar sweeping across a fixed frame, YOU/OPP
point tracks with triangle markers, players left, every game with four quarter boxes. No win %
on it (meters carry that). Meters shorter, each needle shows a dotted start-of-week needle and
the change since (dispatch_out/week_start.json, seeded for Week 9 from the Tue Nov 3 6:06 PM build,
kept by dispatch_run.sh, passed to Live by sync_models.py as wk0). Needs-you panel folded into an
ACTION light in the status line; status is one line with details in the fold-out; extra buttons
(open/close all, keep screen on, copy scores, keys) removed; league header on one line with color.
